title: The Effect Of An Anesthetic Procedure On Post Operative Pain Management In Carpal Tunnel Release
brief_summary: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome patients undergoing carpal tunnel release surgery performed by the PI will receive intra-operative injections of bupivacaine (Marcaine). Two groups of patients will be randomly selected and will receive either 10cc or 20cc of injection. Their post-operative pain scores and usage of post-operative pain medication will be recorded and analyzed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patient must be undergoing carpal tunnel release surgery performed by PI
* EMG or Ultrasound diagnosed carpal tunnel syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* co-musculoskeletal injuries
